config.script:
username=self.session.props.auth.user.userName
	param_id=self.view.params.rowData['param_id']
	row=self.view.params.rowData
	database=self.session.custom.EIM_Config_DB
	
	params={"param_id":param_id,
			"database":database}
	system.db.execUpdate("API/Equipment_Manager/Functions/Delete_Param", params)
	system.perspective.sendMessage("tablerefresh")
	
	##logEvent
	function_name=row['function_name']
	params['function_name']=function_name
	param_name=row['param_name']
	##logEvent

	
	new_row={"function_name":row['function_name'],
			"param_name":row['param_name'],
			"data_type":row['data_type'],
			"required_param":row['required_param'],
			"param_id":row['param_id']
			}

	
	logparams={"username":username,
		   "event_type":"Delete",
		   "before_change":str(new_row),
		   "after_change":None,
		   "description":"Deleted function parameter {0} from function {1}".format(param_name,function_name)}
	API.Functions.log_activity(logparams)
